title: Coal India MT 2026 - Applications Now Open for 660 Posts, Apply at coalindia.in Before June 11
author: Ash K.
summary: Coal India Limited online applications for 660 Management Trainee posts opened on May 12. Last date June 11, 2026. B.E./B.Tech graduates eligible. Starting salary ₹60,000/month. Selection through CBT only - no interview, no GATE required.
body: Coal India Limited (CIL) has opened online applications for 660 Management Trainee (E-1 Grade) posts as per Advertisement No. 03/2026. Registration started on May 12, 2026.

DetailInformation
Total Posts660 (647 fresh + 13 backlog)
Post NameManagement Trainee (E-1 Grade)
Apply StartMay 12, 2026
Last DateJune 11, 2026 (6:00 PM)
EligibilityB.E./B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc in relevant discipline
Age Limit30 years (as on April 30, 2026)
Starting Salary₹60,000/month (Level E-1)
SelectionCBT only - no interview
GATE Required?No
Application Fee₹1,180 (Gen/OBC/EWS), Free for SC/ST/PwBD
Service Bond5 years, ₹3 lakh
Disciplines: Electrical (highest vacancies), Civil, Mechanical, Systems, Electronics & Telecommunication, Geology, Industrial Engineering, Rajbhasha (Hindi), and Company Secretary.

Selection process: Entirely through Computer Based Test (CBT) - no interview, no group discussion. Two papers in a single 3-hour sitting: Paper I (General Aptitude) and Paper II (Professional Knowledge). No negative marking.

Salary and benefits: Starting basic pay of ₹60,000/month with pay scale up to ₹1,80,000. Additional benefits include DA, HRA, cafeteria allowances, medical benefits, pension, and Performance Related Pay. CIL is a Maharatna PSU - among the best-paying government companies.

How to apply: Visit coalindia.in → Career with CIL → Jobs at Coal India → Click on Advt. 03/2026 → Register → Fill form → Upload documents → Pay fee → Submit. Keep the application printout for future reference.

Important note: Final-year students of 2025-26 can apply if they expect results by August 31, 2026. Selected candidates must sign a 5-year service bond of ₹3 lakh. Posting can be anywhere in India, including coalfield areas.
For similar PSU opportunities, check our GATE exam guide and age relaxation rules for government jobs.

faqs.question: When is the last date to apply for Coal India MT 2026?
faqs.answer: The last date to submit the online application is June 11, 2026 at 6:00 PM. Apply at coalindia.in.

faqs.question: Is GATE score required for Coal India MT 2026?
faqs.answer: No. GATE score is not required for this recruitment (Advt. 03/2026). Selection is based entirely on CIL's own CBT exam.

faqs.question: What is the salary of Coal India Management Trainee?
faqs.answer: Starting basic pay is ₹60,000/month in E-1 grade with pay scale up to ₹1,80,000 plus DA, HRA, medical benefits, and performance pay.

faqs.question: Is there negative marking in Coal India MT CBT?
faqs.answer: No. There is no negative marking in the Computer Based Test. Attempt all questions.

faqs.question: Can final year students apply for CIL MT 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. Final-year students of 2025-26 can apply if they get their results by August 31, 2026.

callout.heading: No GATE, No Interview
callout.content: Unlike most PSU recruitments, Coal India MT 2026 does not require GATE score and has no interview stage. Selection is purely through CBT. This makes it accessible to all engineering graduates regardless of GATE performance.
